description: This file contains benchmark tests for various container data structures in the Abseil library, including btree_set, btree_map, and other container types, focusing on performance metrics such as insertion, lookup, deletion, and iterator operations.

classes.name: BigType
classes.description: A customizable large data type used for benchmarking container performance with different object sizes and copy costs.

classes.name: BigTypePtr
classes.description: A wrapper around a unique_ptr to BigType, used for benchmarking container performance with large objects managed via smart pointers.

methods.name: GenerateValues
methods.description: Generates a vector of values in the range [0, 4 * n], with a fixed seed for reproducibility.

methods.name: BM_InsertImpl
methods.description: Benchmark implementation for inserting and erasing values in a container, with optional sorting.

methods.name: BM_Insert
methods.description: Benchmark for inserting values into a container.

methods.name: BM_InsertSorted
methods.description: Benchmark for inserting sorted values into a container.

methods.name: BM_InsertSmall
methods.description: Benchmark for inserting a small number of elements, simulating initial growth of a container.

methods.name: BM_LookupImpl
methods.description: Benchmark for lookup operations in a container.

methods.name: BM_Lookup
methods.description: Benchmark for lookup operations.

methods.name: BM_FullLookup
methods.description: Benchmark for lookup in a fully populated container.

methods.name: BM_Erase
methods.description: Benchmark for erasing elements from a container.

methods.name: BM_EraseRange
methods.description: Benchmark for erasing a range of elements.

methods.name: EraseIfPred
methods.description: Predicate struct for erasing every other element.

methods.name: BM_EraseIf
methods.description: Benchmark for erasing elements based on a predicate.

methods.name: BM_QueueAddRem
methods.description: Benchmark simulating queue-like insertions and removals.

methods.name: BM_MixedAddRem
methods.description: Benchmark for mixed insertions and removals.

methods.name: BM_Fifo
methods.description: Benchmark for FIFO-style insertions and deletions.

methods.name: BM_FwdIter
methods.description: Benchmark for forward iteration over a container.

methods.name: BM_RangeConstructionImpl
methods.description: Benchmark for constructing containers from ranges, with optional sorting.

methods.name: BM_InsertRangeRandom
methods.description: Benchmark for inserting a range of values in random order.

methods.name: BM_InsertRangeSorted
methods.description: Benchmark for inserting a range of sorted values.

methods.name: ContainerInfo
methods.description: Calculates container memory usage and log info for BigType objects.

methods.name: BM_BtreeSet_IteratorSubtraction
methods.description: Benchmark measuring iterator subtraction performance in a btree_set.
